card.name: Verbs of containing or storing in a container
card.fires_on: Verbs or linking words right after a thing and before where it is held, such as is stored, contained, supplied, packaged, placed. The next words would name a container or place.

modes.label: Stored or contained in
modes.description: Passive verb saying an item is kept or held in a container.
modes.example: a given set of letters<< is>> stored. Capital letters were stored in the

modes.label: Supplied or packaged in
modes.description: Verb saying how a product comes packaged, in drug label text.
modes.example: CAMCEVI ETM is<< packaged>> in a blister in the kit.

modes.label: Withdraw and place into
modes.description: Linking word or verb in instructions to move a dose into another container.
modes.example: the container and<< placed>> into a separate container prior to administration.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning 'put in' or 'placed in' a container or place, mostly in Chinese.
card.plain: It fires on words that say something is kept, packaged or placed, just before the container or place is named.
